scope.beginning: The episode begins when Zeus swallows Metis because a prophecy warns of a child who may surpass him.
scope.ending: It ends when Athena springs fully armed from Zeus’ head and is accepted among the gods.

variant.chosenVersion: Common birth of Athena from Zeus after the swallowing of Metis.

relationships.rationale: Zeus and Metis shape Athena Springs from Zeus.
Zeus and Athena shape Athena Springs from Zeus.

narrative.synopsis: Zeus tries to master succession by swallowing Metis, but wisdom cannot be erased. Athena bursts from his head fully armed, becoming a daughter of Zeus and a goddess of strategy.
narrative.openingSituation: A prophecy makes Metis’ pregnancy dangerous to Zeus’ rule.
narrative.centralConflict: Zeus seeks to contain both mother and child inside himself.
narrative.resolution: Athena emerges from Zeus’ head despite the attempt at containment.
narrative.outcome: Wisdom and war-craft enter Olympus as Athena’s domain.

events.consequence: Zeus consumes Metis to avoid the prophecy.
Athena remains unborn within the swallowed mother.
A splitting pain seizes Zeus’ head.
Hephaestus opens the way for the birth.
